content.text: I'll do it with the file tools instead.

I added `itemCount` to all 40 paid orders in `data/orders/`. It's the sum of `qty` across each order's items. I didn't run a separate check of the sums. The `git diff` for the final files shows only the added `itemCount` line (plus the comma after the `items` array) in each. I looked at the full diff for `ord-002` (8 + 1 + 2 = 11).

The other 10 orders have status `pending` or `refunded`, and I didn't touch them. All status values were exact matches, so there were no case or spacing variants like `Paid`.

The files are still 2-space indented JSON. My first write dropped the trailing newline, so I rewrote the 40 files to put it back.
